title: Ronald Reagan: Communicator
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 今天我们聊聊罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: He was president for two terms, and served from 1981 to 1989.
sentences.zh: 他连任两届总统，任期为1981年至1989年。

sentences.en: Before that, he was the governor of California, worked as an actor and led a labor union.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他担任加利福尼亚州州长，曾做过演员，还领导过一个工会。

sentences.en: As president, Reagan is credited for changing the direction of the country.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，里根因改变了国家的发展方向而受到赞誉。

sentences.en: He tried to establish a feeling of confidence in the American people.
sentences.zh: 他努力在美国民众中建立起一种信心。

sentences.en: Although not everyone profited equally from his policies, the president rarely suffered in public opinion polls.
sentences.zh: 尽管并非所有人都从他的政策中同等受益，但这位总统在民意测验中却很少失分。

sentences.en: Reagan was called the “Great Communicator” because he was able to connect with many Americans, and to speak persuasively about conservative values.
sentences.zh: 里根被称为“伟大的沟通者”，因为他能够与众多美国人建立联系，并富有说服力地阐述保守价值观。

sentences.en: He is remembered warmly by many Republican Party politicians and voters especially.
sentences.zh: 尤其是许多共和党政客和选民都对他怀有温暖的记忆。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan is often linked to California and the American West.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根常常与加利福尼亚州和美国西部联系在一起。

sentences.en: But he was born and raised in Illinois, in the center of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但他出生并成长于伊利诺伊州，那里位于美国中部。

sentences.en: His father sold shoes, and his mother mostly took care of Ronald and his older brother, Neil.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲卖鞋，母亲主要照料罗纳德和他年长的哥哥尼尔。

sentences.en: The entire family supported the Democratic Party, especially President Franklin Roosevelt.
sentences.zh: 全家都支持民主党，尤其支持富兰克林·罗斯福总统。

sentences.en: While the boys were growing up, the Reagans did not have much money, and the father suffered from alcoholism.
sentences.zh: 在孩子们成长的过程中，里根一家没有多少钱，父亲还患有酗酒症。

sentences.en: But Ronald was energetic and took part in many activities.
sentences.zh: 但罗纳德精力充沛，参加了许多活动。

sentences.en: He played football and basketball; ran on the track team; swam; acted in plays; led student groups; wrote for school newspapers and yearbooks; and worked several jobs to help pay for his education and support his parents.
sentences.zh: 他踢足球、打篮球；参加田径队；游泳；参加话剧演出；领导学生团体；为学校报刊和年鉴撰稿；并从事几份工作，以帮助支付学费并赡养父母。

sentences.en: He attended Eureka College in Illinois, and completed his studies in 1932.
sentences.zh: 他就读于伊利诺伊州的尤里卡学院，于1932年完成学业。

sentences.en: One of his first jobs out of college was as a sports announcer for a radio station.
sentences.zh: 他大学毕业后的早期工作之一，是担任一家电台的体育解说员。

sentences.en: He had an appealing voice and a natural way of talking that was a good fit for radio.
sentences.zh: 他拥有迷人的嗓音和一种天生的说话方式，非常适合广播。

sentences.en: Reagan was also good-looking, and a dependable worker.
sentences.zh: 里根相貌英俊，还是个值得信赖的工人。

sentences.en: In time, he was offered a chance to act in movies and moved to California.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移,他获得了出演电影的机会,并搬到了加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: During his acting career, Reagan made more than 50 films.
sentences.zh: 在他的演艺生涯中,里根出演了50多部电影。

sentences.en: He also married actress Jane Wyman and had two children with her.
sentences.zh: 他还娶了女演员简·怀曼为妻,并和她育有两个孩子。

sentences.en: But after several years, the relationship ended.
sentences.zh: 然而几年之后,这段关系结束了。

sentences.en: Their marriage ended in divorce.
sentences.zh: 他们的婚姻以离婚告终。

sentences.en: Four years later, Reagan married another actress.
sentences.zh: 四年之后,里根又娶了另一位女演员。

sentences.en: Her name was Anne Robbins, but she was called Nancy Davis.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫安妮·罗宾斯,但大家都称她南希·戴维斯。

sentences.en: They also had two children.
sentences.zh: 他们同样育有两个孩子。

sentences.en: As he was starting his second family, Reagan began another part of his career.
sentences.zh: 正当他开始组建第二个家庭时,里根又开启了他职业生涯的另一部分。

sentences.en: He served as host of a popular television series about the American West.
sentences.zh: 他担任了一部关于美国西部的热门电视剧的主持人。

sentences.en: He also became president of a labor union, the Screen Actors Guild.
sentences.zh: 他还成为了一个工会的会长,即美国演员工会。

sentences.en: It represented actors, announcers, and others working in the film and television industry.
sentences.zh: 该工会代表了在影视行业工作的演员、播音员以及其他人员。

sentences.en: During that time, Reagan’s political beliefs changed.
sentences.zh: 在那段时期,里根的政治信仰发生了变化。

sentences.en: He increasingly supported conservative ideas.
sentences.zh: 他越来越支持保守主义思想。

sentences.en: During public appearances, he often spoke in support of business interests.
sentences.zh: 在公开露面时,他经常发表言论支持商业利益。

sentences.en: He also expressed concern that the federal government was limiting Americans’ freedom.
sentences.zh: 他还表达了对联邦政府正在限制美国人自由的担忧。

sentences.en: The message was well-received by many Americans.
sentences.zh: 这一信息被许多美国人很好地接受。

sentences.en: Although the Democratic Party was in power for most of the 1960s, a number of Americans were becoming increasingly conservative.
sentences.zh: 尽管民主党在20世纪60年代的大部分时间里执政,但许多美国人正变得越来越保守。

sentences.en: Reagan won national recognition in 1966 when he successfully ran for governor of California as a Republican.
sentences.zh: 1966年,里根作为共和党人成功竞选加利福尼亚州州长,从而在全国范围内获得了认可。

sentences.en: In 1970, voters re-elected him to the position.
sentences.zh: 1970年,选民们再次选举他担任这一职务。

sentences.en: But Reagan had set his sights on the presidency.
sentences.zh: 里根早已将目光投向总统之位。

sentences.en: He sought the Republican nomination in both 1968 and 1976.
sentences.zh: 他在1968年和1976年两次寻求共和党提名。

sentences.en: Finally, in 1980, he won the office.
sentences.zh: 最终，在1980年，他赢得了这一职位。

sentences.en: By that time, he had already had several careers, as well as a long life.
sentences.zh: 到那时为止，他已经历了多段职业生涯，也度过了漫长的一生。

sentences.en: At age 69, he was the oldest person until then to be elected president.
sentences.zh: 69岁时，他成为当时当选年龄最大的总统。

sentences.en: When Reagan took office, he made improving the U.S. economy his highest concern.
sentences.zh: 里根就任时，将改善美国经济作为最高 priorities。

sentences.en: One way to do that, he believed, was to reduce the influence of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他认为，实现这一目标的一种方式，就是削弱联邦政府的影响。

sentences.en: He wanted especially to cut some of the government programs that former president Lyndon Johnson had put in place to help poor people.
sentences.zh: 他尤其想削减前总统林登·约翰逊为帮助穷人而设立的一些政府项目。

sentences.en: Reagan believed that cutting taxes – especially on big businesses – would help strengthen the economy, and in time help everyone.
sentences.zh: 里根认为，减税——尤其是对大企业减税——将有助于振兴经济，并最终惠及所有人。

sentences.en: At first, the economy continued to struggle.
sentences.zh: 起初，经济仍在艰难挣扎。

sentences.en: But in a few years, Reagan’s policies appeared to work.
sentences.zh: 但几年之后，里根的政策开始显现成效。

sentences.en: Unemployment dropped, the stock market rose, and many industries grew quickly.
sentences.zh: 失业率下降，股市上涨，许多行业迅速增长。

sentences.en: Americans often remember Reagan’s presidency as a time of economic growth.
sentences.zh: 美国人常常将里根的总统任期回忆成一段经济繁荣的时期。

sentences.en: Not everyone benefited equally, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，并非所有人都同等地受益。

sentences.en: Reagan’s critics observed that his policies largely helped people who were already wealthy.
sentences.zh: 里根的批评者指出，他的政策主要惠及了那些本就富有的人。

sentences.en: The divide between rich and middle-class Americans increased during Reagan’s presidency.
sentences.zh: 在里根任内，富人与中产美国人之间的差距不断扩大。

sentences.en: And Reagan did not reduce government spending in all areas.
sentences.zh: 而且，里根并未在所有领域削减政府开支。

sentences.en: In fact, he sharply increased military spending.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他大幅增加了军事开支。

sentences.en: One result was a large national debt.
sentences.zh: 其结果之一，就是庞大的国家债务。

sentences.en: Another result, Reagan’s supporters say, was a quicker end to the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 另一结果，里根的支持者称，是加速了冷战的结束。

sentences.en: One of Reagan’s major foreign policy goals was to end the stand-off with the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 里根的主要外交政策目标之一是结束与苏联的对峙。

sentences.en: He believed that building up the U.S. military was the best way to pressure the Soviets to reach an agreement on arms control.
sentences.zh: 他认为增强美国军力是迫使苏联就军控问题达成协议的最佳方式。

sentences.en: Reagan also spoke out strongly against communism.
sentences.zh: 里根还强烈反对共产主义。

sentences.en: In his second term, he famously appealed to the new Soviet leader, Mikhail Gorbachev, to tear down the Berlin Wall.
sentences.zh: 在第二任期内，他著名地向新的苏联领导人戈尔巴乔夫呼吁，推倒柏林墙。

sentences.en: For some, the wall was a sign of communism.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，这堵墙是共产主义的象征。

sentences.en: Many historians say Reagan’s policies worked.
sentences.zh: 许多历史学家认为里根的政策奏效了。

sentences.en: For sure, Reagan and Gorbachev improved relations between their countries.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，里根和戈尔巴乔夫改善了他们两国之间的关系。

sentences.en: And in time, the Soviet leadership permitted the Berlin Wall to come down.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，苏联领导层允许柏林墙被推倒。

sentences.en: In addition to the economy and the Cold War, Reagan is often remembered for his likable personality.
sentences.zh: 除了经济和冷战之外，里根还因其讨人喜欢的性格而常被人们铭记。

sentences.en: He spoke easily with the public, often had a positive message about the country, and usually appeared cheerful.
sentences.zh: 他能轻松地与公众交谈，常常传递对国家正面的信息，通常显得心情愉快。

sentences.en: He won even more public approval after a man with mental problems tried to kill him.
sentences.zh: 在一名有精神问题的人试图刺杀他之后，他赢得了更多的公众支持。

sentences.en: The bullets seriously injured several people nearby, and just missed Reagan’s heart.
sentences.zh: 子弹严重击伤了附近的几个人，并险些击中心里根的。

sentences.en: Yet, shortly after he was shot, the president joked with his wife and with his doctors.
sentences.zh: 然而，在他被枪击后不久，这位总统还与他的妻子和医生开了玩笑。

sentences.en: Opinion polls showed that the recovered president was more popular than ever.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，这位康复的总统比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Reagan’s political image also survived a scandal known as Iran-Contra.
sentences.zh: 里根的政治形象也在被称为“伊朗-康特拉”丑闻中幸存下来。

sentences.en: In brief, Congress found that a number of government officials secretly sold U.S. weapons to Iran as part of a deal to free hostages.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，国会发现，多名政府官员秘密地向伊朗出售美国武器，作为释放人质交易的一部分。

sentences.en: Then, the officials used some of the money to help rebels in Nicaragua.
sentences.zh: 随后，这些官员用部分资金帮助尼加拉瓜的反政府武装。

sentences.en: The actions violated congressional rules.
sentences.zh: 这些行为违反了国会的规定。

sentences.en: They also challenged Reagan’s promise that he had not traded weapons for hostages.
sentences.zh: 它们还违背了里根关于他没有以武器交换人质的承诺。

sentences.en: The president apologized for any part he had played in the events.
sentences.zh: 总统为他在这起事件中扮演的任何角色道歉。

sentences.en: Polls showed that, in general, the American public accepted his apology and continued to trust him.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，总体而言，美国公众接受了他的道歉，并继续信任他。

sentences.en: Unlike most U.S. presidents, who lose public support during their terms, Reagan finished his time in office as he had taken it – with the support of more than half of Americans.
sentences.zh: 与大多数在任期内失去公众支持的美国总统不同，里根在完成任期时，正如他接手时一样——获得了超过一半美国人的支持。

sentences.en: Reagan retired to his home in California with his wife, Nancy.
sentences.zh: 里根与妻子南希一起退居加州的家中。

sentences.en: For several years, he wrote about his life and helped organize his presidential library.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，他撰写了自己一生的经历，并协助筹建了他的总统图书馆。

sentences.en: But in a few years, the former president announced that he suffered from Alzheimer’s.
sentences.zh: 然而几年之后，这位前总统宣布自己患上了阿尔茨海默症。

sentences.en: The disease affects people’s ability to think, remember, and express themselves.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病会影响人们思考、记忆和表达自我的能力。

sentences.en: Soon, Reagan disappeared from public life.
sentences.zh: 不久，里根便从公众视野中消失了。

sentences.en: He died in 2004.
sentences.zh: 他于2004年去世。

sentences.en: But he is well-remembered as an able politician who could work effectively with many people.
sentences.zh: 但他作为一位能够与许多人高效合作的能干政治家而被人们深深铭记。

sentences.en: He is also remembered – by both supporters and critics – for being a powerful voice for conservative ideas and traditional values.
sentences.zh: 他同样被支持者与批评者铭记——因为他成为保守理念和传统价值观的有力代言人。

sentences.en: His influence extended beyond his two terms.
sentences.zh: 他的影响延续到了两个任期之外。

sentences.en: Later generations of leaders and voters called themselves Reagan Republicans.
sentences.zh: 后来的几代领导人和选民都自称“里根共和党人”。

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。

glossary.def: a feeling or belief that you can do something well or succeed at something
the ending of a marriage by a legal process
a person who talks to guests on a television or radio show
to be useful or helpful to
an argument or contest in which there is no winner
an occurrence in which people are shocked and upset because of behavior that is morally or legally wrong
to say or show that (something) may not be true, correct, or legal
